t: 埃里斯波在布勒顿城镇延克兰附近击败了鲍德人查尔斯,阻止了西弗朗西亚的扩张.
te: Erispoe defeats Charles the Bald near the Breton town of Jengland, halting the expansion of West Francia.

de: Battle of Jengland: Erispoe defeats Charles the Bald near the Breton town of Jengland, halting the expansion of West Francia.
